$comment: Per-project knobs for the agent system. Every script in .claude/scripts/
reads this instead of hardcoding project facts, so those scripts stay
byte-identical to upstream and `sync-agent-system.sh` can refresh them
without clobbering local edits. Markdown files (skills, agents) name this
file and the key they need; the model resolves it when it reads them.
Omitted keys fall back to project_profile.DEFAULTS. Run
generation time. The rest is yours to tune as the project grows.
$comment_featureHub: Mã dự án trên EZG Feature Hub (tab Features), vd "M001". /publish-feature đọc key này để
biết publish vào catalog nào. Để trống = skill sẽ liệt kê project đang có cho bạn chọn rồi
ghi ngược mã vào đây. Không phải projectName — nhiều repo có thể cùng một mã dự án.
$comment_sensitiveGlobs: Filename globs that mark a diff sensitive and auto-spawn the
security-auditor. This base ships IAP, account sync and a two-tier save,
so those surfaces are covered. Backend/leaderboard/anti-cheat globs are
deliberately ABSENT — add them when the project actually grows one, or
every diff drags in a reviewer with nothing to review.
$comment_backend: No backend in the base template, so the direct-client-write rule is off.
Turn it on when a server lands: set kind, directWriteBanned true, and a
directWritePattern matching the call your client must not make.
